text.description_html:
Custom Single Cylinder Deadbolt, Emtek 8450x8469

This Custom Single Cylinder Deadbolt will fit most pre-drilled doors. It will fit doors with 2-3/4 inch or 2-3/8 inch backsets with thicknesses ranging from 1-3/8 inches to 3 inches. This is a single cylinder deadbolt so the latch is thrown and retracted by a thumb turn on the interior and by a key from the exterior. The exterior trim is 8450 in polished brass and the interior trim is 8469 in polished chrome.

Single Cylinder: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from exterior and by a thumb turn from the interior

Features of the Regular Deadbolt:

  • Keyway: Schlage C
  • Solid brass collar and rosette.
  • Hardened steel bolt.
  • Will fit standard 2-1/8" door preparations.
